four_layer_diagnosis_notes.implementation: Flags reached live ContextMemory.write() under a REEAgent training loop -- BIAS DVs match the unit-level probe (16/16, entropy ~4, round-robin 0.993-0.996) and REFRACTORY occupancy on lock seeds is exactly k+1=3. The load-bearing gate is too weak to distinguish vacuous occupancy from content-addressed occupancy; the non-gating columns (round_robin, entropy, self_repeat vs LEGACY lock) are what actually diagnose.
four_layer_diagnosis_notes.integration: Writes are a sense() side-effect; action selection never consults ContextMemory. Write-count identity across arms at each seed is the fingerprint: swapping the address function did not change episode length.
four_layer_diagnosis_notes.scale: 16 slots, ~3000 writes/cell, 5 seeds. Binding constraint is the address rule, not bank size or write budget.

vacuous_reasons: Writes are automatic sense() side-effects; the agent never selects a write.
Action selection never reads ContextMemory; write counts identical across arms at each seed.
C1_REFRACTORY (>=2 occupied, k=2) is analytically guaranteed: occupancy >= k+1 = 3 by construction; observed 3 on all three lock seeds.
C1_BIAS (>=2) is guaranteed once usage_ema * sqrt(d) dominates mean_scores; observed 16/16, entropy~4, round-robin 0.993-0.996, self_repeat 0 -- occupancy without addressing.

pass_is_real_not_degenerate.why_indexer_did_not_flag_vacuous_pass: criteria_non_degenerate both true (5 seeds >= 2). The vacuous_pass check never engages.
